name: Materialistic
overview: Scripture warns against a materialistic mindset by urging believers to prioritize the kingdom of God and His righteousness above earthly possessions, promising that all necessary things will be provided (Matthew 6:33). The apostle Paul exemplifies this by counting all worldly gains as loss compared to the surpassing value of knowing Christ (Philippians 3:8). Additionally, James cautions that prayers motivated by selfish desires to satisfy material lusts go unanswered, highlighting the spiritual danger of pursuing material things for personal gratification (James 4:3). Together, these verses call Christians to reject materialism and seek Christ-centered values.
